blocks.note: Your basic damaging rotation at level 30 as a Shadow Priest is relatively straightforward: 噬灵瘟疫 is quite Mana-hungry before talenting into 噬灵传染, so you may want to skip casting this if enemies are otherwise dying quickly. Similarly, as discussed earlier, 精神鞭笞 likely does not deal significantly more damage than your Wand attacks at this level, but does reset the 5-Second Rule. Additionally, unlike Wand attacks, Mind Flay is a channeled spell that is affected by spell pushback from enemy attacks. That said, feel free to cast Mind Flay instead of using your Wand if Mana is not an issue. In dungeons, cast 暗言术：痛 on all enemies whenever possible, and make sure to reapply 暗言术：痛 as needed. Ideally, you also want to cast 心灵震爆 on cooldown, but be warned that you may run into issues with both Mana and Threat at this level, depending on your specific circumstances.

When you are in dungeons or fighting multiple enemies, you should focus on dropping your 灼热图腾 and using 火焰新星 as much as possible, until you either risk pulling threat or run out of mana.

items: Send in your pet so it takes aggro.

blocks.note: At this level, your damage comes from DoTs plus a filler. There are two ways to open a pull. Finishing the pullFiller Use your wand by default, and 暗影箭 when you have spare mana. 吸取生命 is also a good choice while questing, especially if you don't have a great wand: the health it drains back covers what your Life Taps cost, so together they effectively turn health into free mana.

title: Rotation for Level 20 Balance Druids in Forever

items: Open with 愤怒 from max range.
Apply 月火术.
Cast 纠缠根须 to hold the target at range.
Cast 愤怒 until the target dies, recasting Entangling Roots if it breaks free, and heal yourself as needed.
Pull up to three or four enemies with 月火术. (If you will naturally pull more, there is no need to cast 月火术 on all targets; it's better to get more hots onto yourself before going into 熊形态)
Cast 回春术 (or 愈合 if you have time) on yourself while they run to you.
Shift into 熊形态.
Cast 挫志咆哮 to reduce their damage.
横扫 until everything is dead.
Cast 精灵之火 to increase your damage on some enemies
Use 狂怒 to generate extra rage for more 横扫, particularly at the start of a pull when your rage is low.

title: Rotation for Level 30 Balance Druids in Forever

items: Hard-Casting Rotation
Pull with 愤怒.
Cast 纠缠根须 to hold the enemy at range.
Cast 星火术 twice.
Cast 愤怒, then follow with two more 星火术.
Repeat the 愤怒 and 星火术 cycle until the enemy dies.

Opening with 愤怒 banks 日月之蚀 charges, so each pair of 星火术 that follows casts faster. If the enemy breaks free of 纠缠根须, stop your current cast and reapply 纠缠根须 before continuing. A 星火术 pushed back by melee hits costs you more time than the recast.

items: Pull with 虫群.

Spread both dots to any additional enemies you want in the pull.
Cast 回春术 on yourself as they close in.
Let the pack hit you, cleaving them with 荆棘术 while you keep your dots and 回春术 running.
If your weapon swings faster than 1.5 seconds, weave melee attacks between your dot refreshes.

items: 变形之力 if you will not waste any Energy, should always be under 50 Energy when used, and 节能施法 is not active.
撕扯 if you have 4/5 combo-points and the target will live for 6 seconds or longer. Never apply if it's already active. Prioritize 5 combo-points if the target lives long enough.

title: Rotation for Level 20 Restoration Druids in Forever

items: Keep 荆棘术 on the tank. It now scales with Spell Power and can provide some much needed threat.
Keep 回春术 up on the tank while fighting.
Wait. The best thing to do in dungeons when there is no healing to be done is to stop casting and let your passive mana regeneration start to tick.
When the tank dips low enough to need a direct heal, cast 愈合. If they already have a 愈合 HoT active, cast 治疗之触.
Run into melee and auto-attack mobs to trigger 清晰预兆 more often.
Spend 清晰预兆 procs on a max rank 愈合 or 治疗之触.
If DPS need healing, give them a rank of 回春术 that will heal them just to 100%. If they die, it's their fault.
When it isn't the DPS player's fault that they're dying, also give them a low rank 治疗之触 to pull them out of the danger zone.
If a pull gets dangerous, CC one mob with 纠缠根须. It can now be used indoors and is a lot more difficult to break.
When mana is not a concern, join in with the DPS: 月火术 -> 愤怒 rotation on the main target.
blocks.note: Restoration Druid Healing is very versatile, and many different rotations succeed at effectively healing group content. Take a crack at playing around with different ranks of your direct heals or refraining from maintaining different HoTs, and see what feels good to you.

title: Rotation for Level 30 Restoration Druids in Forever

items: Keep 荆棘术 up on the tank.
Keep 回春术 up on the tank and anyone you expect to take damage.
Pause casting to regenerate mana, or join in on the DPS when mana is comfortable.
DPS for Deep Balance: 虫群 everything, 纠缠根须 a few mobs away from the tank
DPS for Deep Restoration: Spam 愤怒 or shift to 猎豹形态 for better mana regen.
When a direct heal is needed, start with 愈合 to get the HoT up. Then use low ranks of 治疗之触 to fill the gaps
If a life is in danger, use 迅捷治愈 to pick them up. Even if a HoT is not up yet, 回春术 -> 迅捷治愈 is a 1.0s save.
If 迅捷治愈 is on cooldown or we do not have 1.0s to spare, cast 自然迅捷 with a max rank 治疗之触
When the emergency is party-wide, like too many enemies were pulled and threat is a mess, cast 宁静 to keep everyone alive
